quests.title: Returns at Douglas Park
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I am sending back 49 papers a day from Douglas Park and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Douglas Park
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They will drop my Douglas Park order if I can show $153 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the Sunday after payday. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $153, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Douglas Park Round
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I do the Douglas Park round from first light and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Douglas Park
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. There is a dog on the Douglas Park round that has had two of my bags and a docket book that was not even mine. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Douglas Park
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Nine of us at Douglas Park have gone in on the same numbers since the Sunday after payday and one of us has stopped putting money in. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$49, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Douglas Park
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The agency at Menangle closed six months before Douglas Park started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Tempe
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. There has been a car in the Tempe yard since the Sunday after payday with a chest freezer that hums in D on the passenger seat and no owner answering. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Tempe
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Now that it is documented, Tempe is owed $170 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $170, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Tempe
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I am in my first year at Tempe and I have to log 50 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Tempe
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Somebody has been coming into the Tempe yard after knock-off to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Tempe
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. My car has been at Tempe since the Sunday after payday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $50. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Tempe
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Tempe works out of Marrickville, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. People leave things at the Stanwell Park roller door after half six and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The photos worked, which means Stanwell Park can claim back the $40 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since grand final week. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $40, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Something came into Stanwell Park on grand final week in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Two people have been coming into the Stanwell Park sorting room since grand final week and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$37, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I do the Stanwell Park pick-ups in a van with 37 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: come out to Coalcliff with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Everything Stanwell Park cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Coalcliff, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
